import ast,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
target=root/"core/leases.py"
tests=root/"tests/test_foundation_ledger_leases.py"

assert tests.is_file(),"FOUNDATION_TESTS_MISSING"
code=target.read_bytes()
tree=ast.parse(code,filename=str(target))
test_tree=ast.parse(tests.read_bytes(),filename=str(tests))
found={n.name for n in ast.walk(test_tree) if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
